admissionInfo.note: Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student.
admissionInfo.text: Application for admission to graduate program with application fee by the established deadline. Submit official transcripts from all universities attended. A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited institution. A 3.0 cumulative undergraduate GPA or a 3.0 GPA calculated on the last 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) of undergraduate work. Equivalent undergraduate coursework to the Mathematics Endorsement 4 or Secondary Mathematics Endorsement . A passing score on the Entrance Exam or MATH 6000 Mathematics Core Review. The university uses a selective admissions process for admitting students to graduate programs. Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student.
